events.title: Freddie Mercury tribute
events.blurb: This date marks the anniversary of the death of Queen's iconic frontman, Freddie Mercury, who would have been 80 in 2026.

angles.name: Freddie's Legacy
angles.copy: Remembering the one and only Freddie Mercury today, 35 years since we lost a true rock legend. His voice and stage presence remain unmatched.

events.title: The Beatles' 'Rubber Soul' released
events.blurb: On this day in 1965, The Beatles released their groundbreaking album 'Rubber Soul', marking a pivotal shift in their sound.

angles.name: Rubber Soul Vibe
angles.copy: 59 years ago, The Beatles dropped 'Rubber Soul' – an album that changed everything. What's your favourite track from this masterpiece?

events.title: John Lennon tribute
events.blurb: Today marks the anniversary of the tragic death of John Lennon, who would have been 86 in 2026.

angles.name: Imagine John Lennon
angles.copy: Remembering John Lennon today, a visionary artist whose music continues to inspire generations. His message of peace resonates as strongly as ever.

events.title: David Bowie would have been 80
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of David Bowie, who would have been 80 today.

angles.name: Bowie's Birthday
angles.copy: Eighty years since the birth of the Starman. David Bowie's influence on music, fashion and culture is simply immeasurable.

events.title: Elvis Presley would have been 92
events.blurb: Remembering the King of Rock and Roll, Elvis Presley, who would have been 92 today.

angles.name: The King's Legacy
angles.copy: The King would have been 92 today. Elvis Presley's impact on music is legendary and his tracks still sound incredible.

events.title: Jimmy Page turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary guitarist of Led Zeppelin, Jimmy Page.

angles.name: Guitar God
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to the incomparable Jimmy Page. His riffs shaped rock music forever, and we're still air-guitaring to them.

events.title: Rod Stewart turns 82
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 82nd birthday to the iconic British singer, Sir Rod Stewart.

angles.name: Rod the Mod
angles.copy: Eighty-two years young today! Happy birthday, Rod Stewart. What's your go-to track from the gravel-voiced legend?

events.title: Suggs turns 66
events.blurb: Happy 66th birthday to Suggs, the charismatic frontman of Madness.

angles.name: It Must Be Love
angles.copy: Happy 66th to the one and only Suggs! Here's to the man who brought us so many 'nutty' hits with Madness.

events.title: Paul Young turns 71
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 71st birthday to the soulful British singer, Paul Young.

angles.name: Come Back And Stay
angles.copy: Happy 71st birthday to Paul Young! From The Q-Tips to his solo hits, his voice defined an era.

events.title: Dolly Parton turns 81
events.blurb: Celebrating the 81st birthday of the legendary country music icon, Dolly Parton.

angles.name: Jolene's Creator
angles.copy: Happy 81st birthday to the Queen of Country, Dolly Parton! An absolute icon who continues to shine.

events.title: Gary Barlow turns 56
events.blurb: Happy 56th birthday to Take That frontman and celebrated songwriter, Gary Barlow.

angles.name: Mr. Take That
angles.copy: Fifty-six today! Happy birthday to Gary Barlow, the man behind so many anthems. What's your favourite Take That track?

events.title: Billy Ocean turns 77
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 77th birthday to the Trinidadian-British singer-songwriter, Billy Ocean.

angles.name: Caribbean Queen
angles.copy: Seventy-seven years young! Happy birthday to the legendary Billy Ocean, still making us 'Suddenly' want to dance.

events.title: Rock & Roll Hall of Fame's first induction
events.blurb: On this day in 1989, the Rock and Roll Hall of Fame held its very first induction ceremony, honouring rock's pioneers.

angles.name: Hall of Fame History
angles.copy: It was 1989 when the Rock & Roll Hall of Fame first opened its doors to legends. Who do you think should have been in that inaugural class?

events.title: Mark Owen turns 55
events.blurb: Happy 55th birthday to Take That member, Mark Owen.

angles.name: Take That's Mark
angles.copy: Wishing a very happy 55th birthday to Mark Owen! One-fifth of a certain iconic boyband.

events.title: The Beatles' iconic rooftop concert
events.blurb: On this day in 1969, The Beatles performed their legendary and final public concert on the rooftop of Apple Corps headquarters in London.

angles.name: Rooftop Legends
angles.copy: Fifty-eight years ago today, The Beatles made history with their legendary rooftop concert. What a way to go out!

events.title: Phil Collins turns 76
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 76th birthday to the drumming and singing legend, Phil Collins.

angles.name: In The Air Tonight
angles.copy: Happy 76th birthday to the incredible Phil Collins! A true musical powerhouse, whether behind the kit or the mic.

events.title: Hugh Grant turns 67
events.blurb: Happy 67th birthday to the beloved British actor, Hugh Grant.

angles.name: British Charm
angles.copy: Happy 67th birthday to the king of the rom-com, Hugh Grant! From Notting Hill to Wonka, he's still got that undeniable charm.

events.title: Justin Timberlake turns 46
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 46th birthday to pop superstar, Justin Timberlake.

angles.name: Prince of Pop
angles.copy: Happy 46th birthday to the multi-talented Justin Timberlake! From boyband heartthrob to solo sensation, he's still bringing the 'SexyBack'.

events.title: David Jason turns 87
events.blurb: Happy 87th birthday to the legendary British actor, Sir David Jason.

angles.name: Only Fools and Horses Legend
angles.copy: Eighty-seven today! Happy birthday to national treasure Sir David Jason. What's your favourite Del Boy moment?

events.title: The Day The Music Died anniversary
events.blurb: Today marks 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died' in 1959, when Buddy Holly (who would have been 91), Ritchie Valens (who would have been 86), and The Big Bopper (who would have been 97) tragically died in a plane crash.

angles.name: A Tragic Loss
angles.copy: Remembering Buddy Holly, Ritchie Valens, and The Big Bopper today, 68 years since 'The Day The Music Died'. Their music lives on.

events.title: Rick Astley turns 61
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 61st birthday to the 'Never Gonna Give You Up' singer, Rick Astley.

angles.name: Never Gonna Give Him Up
angles.copy: Happy 61st birthday to the legend himself, Rick Astley! Still got those moves, still got that voice.

events.title: Bob Marley would have been 82
events.blurb: Celebrating the life and legacy of reggae icon Bob Marley, who would have been 82 today.

angles.name: One Love
angles.copy: Eighty-two years since the birth of a true musical revolutionary. Bob Marley's message of peace and unity still resonates globally.

events.title: Carole King turns 85
events.blurb: Happy 85th birthday to the legendary singer-songwriter, Carole King.

angles.name: Tapestry of Talent
angles.copy: Happy 85th birthday to the incomparable Carole King! A songwriting genius whose influence is woven through decades of music.

events.title: Whitney Houston tribute
events.blurb: Remembering the incomparable Whitney Houston, 15 years since her passing. She would have been 64 this year.

angles.name: The Voice
angles.copy: Fifteen years since we lost 'The Voice'. Whitney Houston's incredible talent and legacy live on through her timeless music.

events.title: Take That split anniversary
events.blurb: This day in 1996 marks the emotional announcement that Take That were splitting up, breaking hearts across the nation.

angles.name: A Day of Tears
angles.copy: Remember 1996? The day Take That broke up and hearts shattered across the UK. Thankfully, they came back stronger!

events.title: Ali Campbell turns 68
events.blurb: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell, the distinctive voice of UB40.

angles.name: Red Red Wine
angles.copy: Happy 68th birthday to Ali Campbell! The voice that brought us so many reggae-pop classics with UB40.

events.title: Ed Sheeran turns 36
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 36th birthday to global superstar, Ed Sheeran.

angles.name: Shape of You
angles.copy: Happy 36th birthday to the one and only Ed Sheeran! From acoustic gigs to stadium tours, he's a true musical phenomenon.

events.title: George Harrison would have been 84
events.blurb: Celebrating the life of The Beatles' 'Quiet Beatle', George Harrison, who would have been 84 today.

angles.name: My Sweet Lord
angles.copy: Eighty-four years since the birth of George Harrison. The Quiet Beatle's songwriting genius continues to inspire.

events.title: Roger Daltrey turns 83
events.blurb: Happy 83rd birthday to the legendary frontman of The Who, Roger Daltrey.

angles.name: Rock and Roll Icon
angles.copy: Happy 83rd birthday to The Who's iconic frontman, Roger Daltrey! Still looking good, still sounding great.

events.title: Nik Kershaw turns 69
events.blurb: Wishing a happy 69th birthday to the 80s pop icon, Nik Kershaw.

angles.name: Wouldn't It Be Good
angles.copy: Happy 69th birthday to the brilliant Nik Kershaw! His 80s hits are still absolute bangers.

events.title: Chris Martin turns 50
events.blurb: Happy 50th birthday to Coldplay frontman, Chris Martin.

angles.name: Yellow to Gold
angles.copy: Fifty years young! Happy birthday to Chris Martin, the voice of Coldplay. What's your favourite stadium anthem from the band?

events.title: Jon Bon Jovi turns 65
events.blurb: Wishing a very happy 65th birthday to the legendary Bon Jovi frontman, Jon Bon Jovi.

angles.name: Livin' On A Prayer
angles.copy: Sixty-five years of rock and roll! Happy birthday to Jon Bon Jovi, a true legend of the stage.
